environment.swift: Apple Swift6.3.3, compiled -swift-version5 -O; not an actual Swift5.9 toolchain run
environment.cpu_brand: Unavailable: sandbox denied read-only sysctl query

additional_checks: Learn invalidates cached route inside packet
oversized packet is split without partial-message loss
150000 FIFO callback actions match expected order and values

limits: Synthetic parser/dispatch measurements, not overall app or audio speedups.
No physical MIDI device, hardware round-trip latency or actual UI frame timing measured.
FIFO probe measures MainActor scheduling opportunity, not rendered frame rate.
Drain passes are bounded to32chunks/8192bytes; retained backlog has no hard byte cap, to preserve note/relative events during a stall.
Diagnostic history is sampled at20Hz; it is not a complete MIDI trace.
No absolute event deduplication/coalescing: every original action remains observable.
Mapping persistence is deferred100ms with JSON encoding off the input path; this path was not performance-benchmarked.
